description: This file defines a ProseMirrorTextSerializer class for serializing ProseMirror editor nodes and marks, with specific serializers for inline and display math nodes, used within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: ProseMirrorTextSerializer
classes.description: A class for serializing ProseMirror nodes and marks into text, with customizable serializers for different node and mark types.

methods.name: serializeFragment
methods.description: Serializes a ProseMirror Fragment into a string, handling custom node serialization and text nodes.

methods.name: serializeSlice
methods.description: Serializes a Slice by serializing its content fragment.

methods.name: serializeNode
methods.description: Serializes a single ProseMirror node using custom serializers if available.
